'''0.12e''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that temporarily comprised FPS to decrease desynchronization errors and fixed some crashes associated with combat actions.

==Changelog==
* ~10-fold reduction in desynchronization frequency by reducing the FPS (still working on it)
* Fixed crash after making a kill
* Fixed a crash when placing 3 or more traps
* Fixed crash when an item is attempting to be lifted by two players simultaneously
